summary: Single-crystal hexagonal perovskite YAlO3 was epitaxially grown on GaAs(111)A substrates through nanolaminated atomic layer deposition (ALD) of Y2O3 and Al2O3 multilayers followed by rapid thermal annealing at 900 /C14 C. The study aimed to investigate the formation of a high dielectric constant material for advanced semiconductor applications.
evidence: Single-crystal hexagonal perovskite YAlO3 has been attained through postdeposition rapid thermal annealing with temperatures above 900 /C14 C on nanolaminated atomic-layer-deposited Y2O3 (2.03 nm)/Al2O3 (1.08 nm) multilayers. The perovskite film is epitaxially grown on GaAs(111)A substrates.
